note: Fantasy and antique objects, all physically plausible crafted things in brass, glass, leather, wood and parchment. Nothing glows, nothing is lit, nothing is a weapon, wand or staff, and every dial, globe and cover is wordless: tick marks only, no letters or numerals. A stand or tripod is named in the desc when it is part of the object.
